verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Viam itself accepting a natural-language task description and turning it into a plan it executes. The docs say an external AI agent with a shell or SDK can operate a machine through the CLI or APIs, and the motion service plans collision-free paths. These are developer building blocks for a user's own agent and goal-pose planning, not a first-party natural-language task interface, so they earn no credit for this story.
